observations: For Robin (not graded): in the declared layout the capacitor (generic_1_1, Ø10 at board (19.5, 20.0)) is 0.16 mm from the Pico PCB edge (X 24.66, Z 8.5-9.5) and 0.26 mm from both socket headers (X 24.76). Zero interference, so it passes, but a real electrolytic (diameter tolerance about +0.5 mm) would touch. The layout rule seems to allow 0 mm part-to-part clearance.

Three keep-out margins sit at exactly 0.10 mm (lid lip underside vs V-KO-TOP, floor top vs V-KO-BOT, cavity walls vs the Ø7 V-HOLE-KO columns). They pass as written but leave no slack for print tolerance.

The four lid bosses (OD 6.6) are mostly outside the end-wall corners and run the full height Z -8.1 to 25.2, with matching ears on the lid. This matches the A13 note on corner bosses outside the footprint; renders model_iso.png and open_top.png show them.
